name: ml-ado
description: Set up, work in and audit an Azure DevOps project the same way every time (AzureDevOps-Platform-v1): a setup agent that stops at every approval, a read-only auditor, skills for work items, pull requests, releases, wiki and the audit, and hooks that block a token in a file and dryRun=false without the user's go-ahead. Needs the adoctl command line.
